claimText: Aircraft on reciprocal tracks may be cleared to climb or descend through the levels occupied by other aircraft utilizing on-track DME and/or collocated waypoint or same waypoint, provided that it has been positively established that the aircraft have passed each other and are at least 10 NM apart, or such other value as prescribed by the appropriate ATS authority.
rationale: Permissive clearance condition for reciprocal tracks.
